governance.attested_by: ercot-255 five-year composition (2026-09-07, owner instruction: "Promote the combined result of 2021-22-24-25 along with the 23 config as a single run on the dashboards"). The ONE mechanism this run adds over the ercot-248 composite is ercot_zonal_spread_ep_referenced, armed in 2021/2022/2024/2025 and absent in 2023 (the owner's instruction to leave the 2023 results as registered). It adds ZERO free parameters and ZERO new data: it references the EIA-923-sourced rows of data/raw/ercot_zonal_gas_hub.csv to the SAME measured statewide series (ercot_electric_power_gas_basis) that the level term already carries, instead of to Henry Hub. The rows mix two provenance classes -- F923 delivered prices (statewide LEVEL + locational differential) and cited hub-vs-hub conventions (differential only) -- so the capacity-weighted mean-zero recentring cannot drop the 923 level bias its own docstring claims it drops, and the surviving term is ep_basis itself: a rule-19 [R-ONE-MECH] double count of a statewide quantity, ~nil in the training years and +5.2779 $/MMBtu in 2021. NOTHING IS FIT TO ANY RESIDUAL: there is no weighting choice to make, the construction is an identity, and its level neutrality at its own seam is MACHINE ZERO in every year measured (-5.5e-17 / -1.9e-17 / -4.9e-16 for 2023/2025/2021). The screen year was named ex ante on the mechanism's own footprint and no gate was ever read against the target criterion (rule 29 [R-SCREEN]). Record: docs/PRECOMMIT-ercot255-zonal-spread-ep-reference-2026-09-07.md, its G-1c addendum, and docs/RESULT-ercot255-zonal-spread-ep-reference-2026-09-07.md. Prior attestation (ercot-248) preserved below in lineage. || ercot-248 consolidation (2026-09-05): composite of the two designated configs, each attested by its own session — forward 2024/2025: ercot-234 session (2026-08-25): the card Z-A IDENTITY REPAIR on the ercot-231 keeper recipe (PRECOMMIT-ercot234-eastex-identity-repair-2026-08-25.md, blob-verified before any derivation; FINDING-ercot234-eastex-identity-repair-2026-08-25.md) — ZERO fitted scalars, zero parameters added. EASTEX (ERCOT's East Texas GTC, the constraint that physically exists at the model's Northeast->North boundary: 'flows out of the East Texas area', Tyler/Lufkin/Nacogdoches — market notice #1557) replaces the geographically mis-attributed NE_LOB (North Edinburg-Lobo, Rio Grande Valley) in constants.ERCOT_GTC_LINK_MAP; the static export rating re-derives 1,300 -> 2,300 MW as the NP6-86 mean-limit-at-bind pooled 2023+2024 (instrument reproduced WESTEX +0.20% / PNHNDL +0.05%; P-1 Amendment-1 records that the replaced 1,300 was hand-rounded, never instrument-derived). The identity, boundary and static all trace to published/committed measured sources; the 2023 official regression (C3a -38.0 -> -39.7%) is the mis-attributed gain returned, kept per rule 14 — nothing was fit to any residual and no output is pinned to actuals. Prior attestation (ercot-231) preserved below in lineage. || 2023 carve-out: ercot-236 session (2026-08-25): the h4097 manufactured-shed repair + k_peak re-selection under the standing 2023-DISCRETE-CONFIG owner order (ercot-235 log entry; rule-16 waiver invoked, Q-B/R-A superseded by the owner). The ercot-235 keeper recipe with TWO deltas: (1) ercot_offer_swcap_clip=true — the STRUCTURAL system-wide offer cap (every real SCED energy offer is capped at the SWCAP $5,000 = VOLL; the model offer surface previously had no cap, so k_peak > 24 walked implied offers past VOLL and manufactured the h4097 shed against physically-available capacity — D-1 measured: thermal -48.28 MW undispatched at all-zone $5,000, storage +12.33, net reserve held 0.0; PRECOMMIT-ercot236 Amendment 1). The clip carries ZERO fitted values (the cap is the documented market constant; the 0.01 epsilon is a dispatch-before-shed strict-preference tiebreaker in the R-EPSILON class) and is measured INERT below the cap (V-0: k=24+clip officials identical to the keeper to the digit). (2) k_peak 24 -> 33, re-selected on the repaired surface by the precommitted kill-gated {27, 30, 33} re-bracket (kills identical to PRECOMMIT-ercot235: no shed, off-season protected at $5, coal 0.5 TWh — the winner is CLEAN on all; coal +0.0993 TWh vs the ercot-234 baseline, +0.0001 vs the k24 keeper). The tuned scalar remains declared in the DOF ledger (n_residual 7, unchanged); the identification is the 2023 residual and is stated as such — the rule-1 sanctioned tuning surface, not a hidden channel; no output is pinned to actuals and no measured outcome is fed back as an input. 2023-only by owner order; 2024/2025 deliberately not solved (the cross-year keeper 2026-08-25-234-eastex-identity is their standing reference).

exceptions.magnitude: model 22 h vs actual RT 53 h > $200/MWh (re-measured on the ercot-231 combined arm)
exceptions.reason: OWNER DECISION 2026-08-05 (ERCOT 2023 diagnosis session; directive: 'make C3c an accepted caveat because of known limitations of LP modeling underestimating the scarcity tail — across all 3 years'). ACCEPTED MODEL-CLASS LIMITATION (rubric v3.0, kind=model-class, supporting tier): the realized RT tail was formed on ERCOT's ENERGY offer stack — GWs offered across $500-3,000, 0.91 of the 1.10 GW offered >=$500 at the top-100 gap hours being storage (ercot-161) — with measured RTORPA p50 ~$1-5 and PRC p50 ~5.8 GW at the missed hours (no ORDC scarcity to recover: ercot-102, ercot52 cap-dual). An LP whose offers are competitive/measured marginal cost cannot form that equilibrium conduct, and the within-class mechanism space is exhausted: the measured storage RT offer surface REFUTED (ercot-162, discharge collapses ~74%/yr); the reserve/quantity families BISTABLE or killed (online-capacity envelope ERCOT-107/108 963-vs-69 h; energy_online_capability_cap 4 kill gates ERCOT-159; ORDC-LOLP swap ERCOT-97 lane 3; AS-plan netting rejected, backcast-measured-data-audit §); the '8 GW cheap CC offline block' premise refuted (ERCOT-163). Exhaustion record: ercot-95/97/102/107/108/155/159/161/162/163. OPEN RESIDUAL LANE — this caveat does NOT close root-causing: the AS-vs-energy split of storage capability at scarcity (FINDING-ercot162-storage-rt-surface-refuted-2026-08-04 §2) and the CC headroom/capability identification (calibration-log/ercot.md ercot-163 close-out); a mechanism that lands there simply PASSes this criterion and this entry goes inert. CARRIED ONTO THE ercot167 KEEPER at the 2026-08-05 owner promotion (magnitudes updated to this run's counts; the owner decision applies to the ERCOT keeper lane and the exhaustion record is unchanged - the ercot-167 quantity mechanism moved the counts 58/20/0 -> 61/25/3, nowhere near the [0.5x] band, exactly as the model-class limitation predicts). CARRIED ONTO THE ercot-168 CANDIDATE (counts UNCHANGED by the arm: 61/25/3 - the year-curve repricing is deep inframarginal in every actual tail hour, exactly as the model-class limitation predicts). CARRIED ONTO THE ercot-185 ARM: the fault-3 construction repair is an AVAILABILITY-envelope change on measured plateau hours and the exhaustion record is unchanged; the counts are re-measured on this run and reported at full magnitude. CARRIED ONTO THE ercot-188 ARM: the (c2) refinement changes the RESOLUTION at which the model can quote its own supply curve, not the offer conduct the measured surfaces represent, and the exhaustion record is unchanged — ercot-184 measured the whole family of MW-preserving re-slicings at a +$1.99/MWh ceiling because the LP's clearing position is a QUANTITY fact; the counts are re-measured on this run and reported at full magnitude. CARRIED ONTO THE ercot-192 ARM: the year-keyed 2023 `_peak` level raises the price at which the model's coal TOP tranche is willing to clear, which is a supply-curve LEVEL correction and not a scarcity-formation mechanism — the accepted model-class limitation is that an LP on competitive/measured offers cannot form ERCOT's realized RT tail equilibrium, and nothing in a measured offer level changes that. The counts are re-measured on this run and reported at full magnitude. CARRIED ONTO THE ercot-215 COUNTERPART-DECONTAMINATION PROMOTION, AND RE-OPENED AT FULL WIDTH: the ercot-213 keeper's tail gains (2023 123/181, 2024 33/53) were measured at ercot-214 §2 to ride the AS-product shortfall-ramp leak — a phantom price-formation channel (116/117 of 2023's deep adder hours contaminated; published settled RTORPA p50 $14.2 there, > $100 in only 15 h vs the arm's 117; the real 2023 tail was conduct-made, actual > $200 in 181 h against 17 h of > $100 published adder). Removing the channel returns the tail to this model-class ledger where ercot-209/211 adjudicated it: the accepted limitation is unchanged in kind — an LP on competitive/measured offers cannot form ERCOT's realized RT tail equilibrium, and a decontaminated reserve adder no longer manufactures it through a channel the market does not have. The count is re-measured on this run and reported at full magnitude. CARRIED ONTO THE ercot-231 COMBINED PROMOTION, WITH THE OPEN RESIDUAL LANE RE-WORDED AS SPENT (the re-wording owed since ercot-216, discharged here): ercot-216 (2026-08-17) spent the lane's both named candidates — (a) the storage AS-vs-energy split is ercot_storage_as_soc_reserve, armed since ercot-167 with its re-gate discharged RG-PASS (ercot-193), and (b) the CC headroom identification is item 11, FILED-UNLICENSED twice and CLOSED by the signed card-Q rule (Q-B automatic and final, ercot-191) — and measured the object empty on the keeper (dispatch matched fuel-by-fuel at the missed hours, RTORPA ~$1, PRC 5.7-7.7 GW). The 'a mechanism that lands there simply PASSes' clause therefore names no live route; the accepted limitation now rests on the full exhaustion record — AS procurement closed (ercot-226/227: every armed factor left d_price_at_miss at 0.0), the within-year conduct family complete at every member (ercot-221/222/223/230: the keeper is the measured fixed point of its own adaptation map), and the non-AS tightness surface swept (ercot-231). The ercot-231 combined arm moves the count by PLACEMENT, not by scarcity formation: the measured DC-tie tie-zone attribution plus the measured-GTC restoration are physical-input repairs (zero fitted scalars) that let the existing competitive stack clear where the load actually sits. The counts are re-measured on this run and reported at full magnitude.
